combiner_leakage_mitigation: Every physical image is mapped to a single immutable global_group_id in global_image_group_manifest.parquet. Any image evaluated in POPE or FaithScore held-out test splits is assigned combiner_partition='held_out_test' with eligible_for_combiner_training=False. The 22 COCO images shared between POPE (test) and A-OKVQA (val) are explicitly barred from combiner training to prevent image-level leakage.
